statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-60747 is an Oracle MySQL Server vulnerability in the Server: Replication component (CVSS 3.1 base score 6.2): an unauthenticated attacker with logon to the host that runs the server can cause a hang or repeatable crash of the server. MariaDB lists CVE-2026-60747 among the security fixes of MariaDB 11.4.13, released on 24 Aug 2026 (https://mariadb.com/docs/release-notes/community-server/11.4/11.4.13); the release notes of MariaDB 11.4.12, released on 27 May 2026, do not list it, and MariaDB has not published the individual fix commit. Alpine records the fix at mariadb 11.4.13-r0 in its 3.23 security database (https://secdb.alpinelinux.org/v3.23/main.json), and Debian tracks it at https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-60747 . We checked every mariadb build published in the DHI Alpine 3.23 repository as of 2026-11-27, 11.4.9-r0, 11.4.10-r0, 11.4.11-r0, 11.4.12-r0, 11.4.13-r0 and 11.4.14-r0, on x86_64 and aarch64: the embedded server library libmariadbd.so.19 in each build's mariadb-embedded subpackage carries the MariaDB server version string that matches its package version (11.4.9-MariaDB to 11.4.14-MariaDB). 11.4.13-r0 is the first build on a MariaDB release that includes the fix, so the range ends there and the earlier builds are affected.

statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-60747 is an Oracle MySQL Server vulnerability in the Server: Replication component (CVSS 3.1 base score 6.2): an unauthenticated attacker with logon to the host that runs the server can cause a hang or repeatable crash of the server. MariaDB lists CVE-2026-60747 among the security fixes of MariaDB 11.8.9, released on 24 Aug 2026 (https://mariadb.com/docs/release-notes/community-server/11.8/11.8.9); the release notes of MariaDB 11.8.8, released on 27 May 2026, do not list it, and MariaDB has not published the individual fix commit. Debian fixes it in trixie with mariadb 1:11.8.9+ds-0+deb13u1 (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-60747). Every mariadb build published in the DHI Debian repository as of 2026-11-27 is one of four DHI rebuilds of Debian's mariadb 1:11.8.6-0+deb13u1, each with 56 binary packages per architecture including the -dbgsym packages, on amd64 and arm64. That Debian version predates MariaDB 11.8.9, and the Debian changelog shipped in each of the four builds on both architectures does not mention this CVE: the DHI rebuilds add backports only for other MariaDB advisories, each named in the changelog. Every published build is therefore affected until the owner ships MariaDB 11.8.9 or a backport of its fix.
